summary: A comprehensive spiritual and astrology platform MVP inspired by apps like AstroSage/Anytime Astro. Covers temple services, horoscope/panchang, astrologer consultation (booking/scheduling with dashboard), spiritual shop with Stripe payments, reports, devotional content, virtual home temple, numerology, and business name/logo analysis via astrology and numerology.
architectural_notes: Use AstrologyAPI.com or Prokerala for Panchang, Kundli, and Rashifal calculations; build with API key placeholder so it can be swapped in
Real-time astrologer chat/call replaced with appointment booking/scheduling system; astrologer confirms via in-app dashboard
Stripe integration for spiritual shop checkout and wallet recharge
Audio files stored as base64 in Motoko stable storage; Admin CMS uploads audio for Bhajan Library, Vrat Katha, and Holy Books sections
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Nav Grah deity collage banner — 9 planetary deities (Surya, Chandra, Mangal, Budh, Guru, Shukra, Shani, Rahu, Ketu) arranged in a circular mandala pattern with saffron and gold tones on a deep maroon background (navgrah-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
- Holy Books Audio page hero banner — ancient Sanskrit manuscript scrolls with a glowing diya and gold Om symbol overlaid on a warm cream and saffron gradient (holy-books-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
- Bhajan Library page hero banner — group of devotees singing bhajans with musical instruments (tabla, harmonium, manjira) rendered in watercolor style with saffron and gold palette (bhajan-library-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
- Vrat Katha page hero banner — open holy book / katha granth with flower petals and a lit diya in warm orange and gold tones (vrat-katha-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
- Rudraksha product placeholder image — close-up of a 5-mukhi Rudraksha mala bead strand on a wooden surface with warm lighting (rudraksha-product.dim_400x400.png)
- Nav Grah Murti product placeholder image — decorative brass idol set of all 9 Nav Grah deities on a red velvet background (navgrah-murti-product.dim_400x400.png)

existing_features.title: Build a full-featured React frontend with a rich spiritual/devotional visual theme — deep saffron, gold, cream, and maroon color palette, ornate typography (using a serif/Devanagari-inspired Google Font), temple-motif dividers and decorative borders, warm gradient backgrounds, and glowing sacred iconography. Apply this theme consistently across all pages and components.

Implement a Temple Services section with four subsections: (1) Puja Booking — a form with temple selector (50+ renowned Indian temples listed: Tirupati, Vaishno Devi, Kashi Vishwanath, Shirdi Sai Baba, Somnath, Jagannath Puri, Kedarnath, Badrinath, Golden Temple, Meenakshi Amman, and 40+ more), devotee name, gotra, puja type, preferred date, and special wishes; bookings stored in the backend and shown in the user dashboard. (2) Virtual Chadhava — an interactive offerings panel where users select items (flowers, fruits, coconut, sweets, incense) for a chosen temple and submit the offering, stored in the backend. (3) Prasad Home Delivery — a form to request prasad from a chosen temple with delivery address and mobile number, stored as a delivery request. (4) Virtual Aarti — an interactive animated screen with a diya (click to light/flame animation), temple bell (click to ring with visual ripple effect), and shankh/conch (click to blow with sound-wave animation), all client-side with CSS/React state animations.

Build a Horoscope & Panchang section with: (1) Daily Panchang page showing Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karan, Sunrise/Sunset, Shubh Muhurat, and Rahukaal — use mock/static placeholder data structured to match AstrologyAPI.com or Prokerala API response format, with a clearly commented placeholder indicating where to insert the API key and endpoint call. (2) Vrat Calendar — a monthly calendar view highlighting fasting days (Ekadashi, Pradosh, Purnima, Amavasya, major Hindu festivals) with static data for the current year. (3) Rashifal — a zodiac sign selector (all 12 rashis with symbols) and tabs for daily/weekly/yearly predictions; display placeholder prediction text for each rashi. (4) Kundli Generation — a form collecting name, date of birth, time of birth, and place of birth; on submit, display a placeholder birth chart wheel (SVG or canvas-based 12-house wheel) with house divisions and a table of planetary positions (mocked data), with a comment block showing where to integrate AstrologyAPI.com/Prokerala for live calculations.

Build an Astrologer Consultation section with: (1) Astrologer listing page showing profiles (photo placeholder, name, specializations such as Vedic Astrology/Tarot/Numerology/Vastu/Palmistry, experience years, rating, per-minute rate, languages). Seed at least 8 astrologer profiles in the backend. (2) Individual astrologer profile page with full bio, reviews, and a 'Book Appointment' button. (3) Appointment booking form: user fills in their name, contact, preferred date/time slot, consultation topic (dropdown: Career, Marriage, Health, Finance, General), and special questions; form submits appointment request to backend with status 'pending'. (4) Astrologer/admin dashboard (accessible via a protected route or a simple password-gated admin panel) where astrologers can view all pending appointment requests, confirm or cancel them, and add notes; dashboard shows appointment list with user details, topic, and requested time.

Build a Spiritual Shop section with: (1) Product catalog displaying items across categories: Gemstones (Green Aventurine, Lapis Lazuli, Pyrite, Amethyst, Opal, Tiger Eye, Citrine, Quartz, Green Jade), Yantras (Shree Yantra, Kuber Yantra, Ganesh Yantra, Vastu Yantra), Bracelets (Dhan Yog Bracelet, Raj Yog Bracelet, Navratna Bracelet), and Ritual Items (Rudraksha, Puja Kits, Incense). Seed at least 20 products in the backend with name, description, category, price, benefits, and astrological purpose. (2) Product detail page with full description, benefits, energization details, and Add to Cart. (3) Shopping cart with item quantity management and order total. (4) Stripe checkout integration — on placing order, create a Stripe PaymentIntent from the backend (store publishable key as a constant, mark secret key placeholder clearly), render Stripe Elements card form on frontend, confirm payment, and update order status to 'paid' in the backend. (5) Wallet recharge — user can add funds (₹100, ₹500, ₹1000, ₹2000) to their platform wallet via Stripe; wallet balance displayed in the user dashboard.

Build a Reports section offering the following report types: Birth Chart, Varshphal (Solar Return), Lal Kitab, Sade Sati, Raj Yog, Kaal Sarp Dosh, Rahu-Ketu Transit, Mangal Dosh, Nakshatra Report, Daily Prediction, Love Compatibility, Wealth Report, Education Report, Health Report, Palmistry Report, and Personalized Life Report. Display a report catalog page with each report card showing name, description, price, and a 'Request Report' button. On clicking, user fills a form with their birth details (name, DOB, TOB, POB) and submits; request is stored in backend with status 'pending'. Show a user report history in the dashboard. For a selected set of reports (Birth Chart, Sade Sati, Raj Yog, Kaal Sarp Dosh), display a detailed mock/placeholder report output page with structured sections (e.g., planetary positions table, interpretation paragraphs, remedies).

Build a Devotional Content Library section with a tabbed interface for Bhajans, Aartis, Mantras, and Chalisas. Seed at least 15 content entries in the backend across these categories (e.g., Hanuman Chalisa, Ganesh Aarti, Gayatri Mantra, Om Jai Jagdish Hare, Durga Chalisa, Mahamrityunjaya Mantra, Shiv Tandav Stotram, etc.) with title, deity, type, full lyrics/text, and language (Hindi/Sanskrit/English transliteration). Display content in a card grid; clicking a card shows the full text with verse formatting. Include a search/filter bar to filter by deity or type.

Build a Virtual Home Temple section where users can personalize their digital temple. Present a visual temple setup interface with options to: choose a primary deity (Ganesh, Shiva, Vishnu, Durga, Lakshmi, Saraswati, Krishna, Ram, Hanuman), select decor style (Simple, Traditional, Grand), choose a background (Mountains, River, Forest, Temple Hall), and add items (diya, flowers, incense, bell). Display the composed virtual temple as a styled card/panel updating in real-time as the user makes selections. Save the configuration to the backend per user (using a simple user ID stored in local state for MVP). Show a 'Visit My Temple' option in the dashboard that loads their saved configuration.

Build a Numerology section with three tools: (1) Personal Numerology — user enters full name and date of birth; display Moolank (Driver/Life Path number), Bhagyank (Destiny number), Name Number (Chaldean), and Lo Shu Grid visualization (3x3 magic square with numbers from birth date plotted, highlighting present and missing numbers) with interpretation text for each number. (2) Mobile Numerology — user enters a mobile number; calculate and display the numerological sum, ruling planet, and interpretation for personal/business use. (3) Name Compatibility — enter two names/dates; compute compatibility score based on numerological values and display a compatibility summary. All calculations performed client-side in the frontend using Chaldean numerology logic.

Build a Business Name & Logo Astrology section with five tools: (1) Business Name Analyzer — user enters a business name and their birth date; compute Chaldean numerology value of the name, Moolank and Bhagyank from birth date, display compatibility assessment, ruling planet of the business name, and astrological recommendations (lucky days, colors, gemstones for the business). (2) Logo Color & Design Guidance — user selects their rashi (zodiac sign) and ruling planet; display recommended lucky colors for logo, auspicious symbols, and design element suggestions. (3) Name Correction Tool — user enters a business name; display the current numerological value and suggest 3–5 alternate spellings (by adding/changing letters) that result in more favorable numbers (6, 5, 1, or 9 in Chaldean), showing the new number for each suggestion. (4) Company Name Generator — user enters birth date, desired business purpose (dropdown: Wealth, Fame, Stability, Creativity, Leadership, Healing), and optional keyword; generate 5–8 business name suggestions with their Chaldean values. (5) Lo Shu Grid for Business — user enters business name; map the letters' numbers onto a 3x3 Lo Shu Grid, highlight strong and missing positions, and provide interpretation of strengths and remedies for missing numbers. All calculations performed client-side.

Build a User Dashboard page that consolidates all user activity: (1) My Puja Bookings — list of submitted puja bookings with temple name, date, and status. (2) My Consultation Appointments — list of booked astrologer appointments with astrologer name, topic, date/time, and status (pending/confirmed/cancelled). (3) My Reports — list of requested reports with type and status. (4) My Orders — list of shop orders with items and payment status. (5) My Wallet — current balance with recharge button. (6) My Temple — link to virtual home temple. (7) My Chadhava & Prasad — history of offering and delivery requests. Use a sidebar or tab-based layout. For MVP, identify users by a simple UUID stored in browser localStorage.

Build a main homepage / landing page with: a hero section featuring an animated Om symbol or temple silhouette, a tagline ('Your Complete Spiritual Companion'), and quick-access CTAs for the major sections; a featured temples row; a zodiac sign quick-selector linking to Rashifal; a featured shop products row; a 'Why Choose Us' section highlighting key features; a devotional quote of the day (rotated from a static list); and footer with all section links, contact info placeholder, and social links.

In the frontend Spiritual Shop page (frontend/src/pages/SpiritualShop.tsx), add the four new product categories — Rudraksha, Nav Grah Murti, Nav Grah Yatra, and Devi Devta Yatra — to the category filter tabs/buttons so users can browse and filter products by these categories. Ensure product cards, detail pages, and add-to-cart flow work identically to existing categories.

Add a dedicated Bhajan Library page (frontend/src/pages/BhajanlLibrary.tsx) as a standalone section separate from the existing Devotional Content Library. The page must feature a full music player UI with play/pause, next track, previous track, playlist queue display, repeat mode, and shuffle mode controls. Pre-load at least 12 mock bhajan entries (title, artist/deity, duration placeholder, lyrics text, placeholder audio URL) rendered as a playlist. Include both a typing search bar and a voice search button (using Web Speech API SpeechRecognition, with graceful fallback if unsupported) to filter the bhajan list by title or deity. The player should show currently playing track name, a progress bar (non-functional/mock for placeholder audio), and track artwork placeholder. Add a 'Bhajan Library' nav link in the main Layout header and footer.

Add a dedicated Vrat Katha page (frontend/src/pages/VratKatha.tsx) at route /vrat-katha. Seed at least 10 Vrat Katha entries in the backend with: title, vrat/festival name (e.g., Ekadashi Katha, Solah Somvar Katha, Satyanarayan Katha, Ganesh Chaturthi Katha, Navratri Katha, Karva Chauth Katha, Pradosh Katha, Shivratri Katha, Janmashtami Katha, Diwali Lakshmi Puja Katha), full story text (mock placeholder paragraphs in Hindi/English), audio URL (placeholder), and festival type. The frontend page displays katha entries in a card grid. Clicking a card opens a detail view showing the full story text with paragraph formatting and an audio player bar (play/pause, with placeholder audio source). Add 'Vrat Katha' to the main nav and footer links.

Add a dedicated Holy Books Audio page (frontend/src/pages/HolyBooksAudio.tsx) at route /holy-books. Seed the backend with at least 12 holy book entries covering all major Hindu texts: Bhagavad Gita (18 chapters as tracks), Ramcharitmanas (7 Kandas), Shrimad Bhagavatam (overview + selected cantos), Rigveda (sample suktas), Samaveda, Yajurveda, Atharvaveda, Hanuman Chalisa (full path recitation), Sundarkand, Durga Saptashati (13 chapters), Vishnu Sahasranama, and Shiva Mahimna Stotram. Each entry has: bookTitle, chapter/track title, shloka/verse text (mock Sanskrit + transliteration), audioUrl (placeholder), bookCategory (Veda/Purana/Stotra/Epic), and trackNumber. The frontend page has a sidebar/accordion list of books with their chapters. Selecting a chapter loads it in a central music-player panel with play/pause, next chapter, previous chapter, chapter list navigation, and the shloka text displayed below the player. Add 'Holy Books' to main nav and footer.

Add an Admin CMS section as a separate password-gated page (frontend/src/pages/AdminCMS.tsx) at route /admin-cms, distinct from the existing AstrologerDashboard. It must require a hardcoded password (e.g., 'admin2024') entered in a gate form before access is granted. The CMS has three tabs: (1) Bhajan Library Management — admin can add a new bhajan (title, deity, artist, lyrics text, audio file upload converted to base64) and view/delete existing bhajan entries; (2) Vrat Katha Management — admin can add/edit/delete katha entries (title, festival name, story text, audio file upload as base64); (3) Holy Books Management — admin can add new book chapters (bookTitle, chapterTitle, shloka text, audio file upload as base64, bookCategory). Audio files uploaded via the CMS are stored as base64 Text in the Motoko backend. Backend must expose update/create/delete endpoints for bhajan, vrat katha, and holy book audio entries accessible only with an admin principal check or a simple flag.

Add React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for the new backend endpoints: useBhajans(), useVratKathas(), useHolyBookEntries(bookTitle), useAddBhajan(), useUpdateBhajan(), useDeleteBhajan(), useAddVratKatha(), useUpdateVratKatha(), useDeleteVratKatha(), useAddHolyBookEntry(), useDeleteHolyBookEntry(). These hooks follow the same pattern as existing hooks in that file.

Update the main App.tsx router to add routes for the four new pages: /bhajan-library (BhajanLibrary), /vrat-katha (VratKatha), /holy-books (HolyBooksAudio), /admin-cms (AdminCMS). Update the Layout.tsx navigation header to include links for 'Bhajan Library', 'Vrat Katha', and 'Holy Books' in the appropriate nav section (devotional/content group). Update the footer in Layout.tsx to include all four new section links. Update the Home.tsx landing page to add CTA cards or quick-access buttons for Bhajan Library, Vrat Katha, and Holy Books in the features/quick-access section.

Reports system: Birth chart, Varshphal, Lal Kitab, Sade Sati, Raj Yog, Kaal Sarp Dosh, and more with request & delivery

Create a Motoko backend with stable storage for: users (name, email, birth details, gotra), puja bookings (temple, name, gotra, date, status), chadhava offerings, prasad delivery requests, astrologer profiles (name, specializations, bio, rating), consultation appointment requests (user, astrologer, date/time, topic, status: pending/confirmed/cancelled), spiritual shop products (name, category, price, description, stock), orders (items, total, payment status, Stripe payment intent ID), wallet balances and transaction history, report requests (type, user details, status, content), devotional content entries (title, type: bhajan/aarti/mantra/chalisa, content/lyrics), virtual temple configurations (per user: deity, decor choices), numerology analysis records, and business name analysis records.
Spiritual Shop: Add Rudraksha (expanded), Nav Grah Photo Murti, Nav Grah Yatra Photos, Devi-Devta Photo Yatra as new product categories
Standalone Bhajan Library page with full music player (play/pause, next/prev, playlist, repeat/shuffle), voice + typing search, pre-loaded mock content
Nav Grah mantras (all 9 planets) and major Devi-Devta mantras added to existing Devotional Library Mantras tab
Vrat Katha dedicated page with stories/kathas for major vrats & festivals, mock text + placeholder audio with playback controls
Holy Books Audio dedicated section/page with chapter-based music player; all major Hindu holy books (Bhagavad Gita, Ramcharitmanas, Vedas, Upanishads, etc.) with real shloka text + placeholder audio
Admin CMS separate password-gated section for uploading/managing audio (base64 in Motoko) for Bhajan Library, Vrat Katha, and Holy Books; also manages Vrat Katha text content

Extend the Spiritual Shop backend data by adding new product categories and seeding at least 20 additional products: Rudraksha (individual bead types: 1-mukhi through 14-mukhi, Gauri Shankar, Ganesha, Siddha Rudraksha — each as a separate product with name, description, category='Rudraksha', price, benefits, astrological purpose); Nav Grah Photo Murti (all 9 planetary deity idols: Surya, Chandra, Mangal, Budh, Guru, Shukra, Shani, Rahu, Ketu — each as a separate product with category='Nav Grah Murti'); Nav Grah Yatra Photos (pilgrimage photo prints for the 9 Nav Grah temples, category='Nav Grah Yatra'); Devi-Devta Photo Yatra (deity yatra photo collection for major deities: Durga, Lakshmi, Saraswati, Kali, Shiva, Vishnu, Krishna, Ram, Hanuman, Ganesh — category='Devi Devta Yatra'). All products must be accessible through the existing getProducts, getProductById, and addToCart/checkout flows.

Add Nav Grah mantras for all 9 planets (Surya, Chandra, Mangal, Budh, Guru/Brihaspati, Shukra, Shani, Rahu, Ketu) and at least 10 major Devi-Devta mantras (e.g., Durga Mantra, Lakshmi Mantra, Saraswati Mantra, Ganesh Mantra, Shiva Panchakshara, Vishnu Mantra, Krishna Mantra, Hanuman Mantra, Ram Mantra, Kali Mantra) as new seeded entries in the backend devotional content store. Each entry must have title, deity, type='Mantra', full Sanskrit text with Hindi/English transliteration, and language tag. These entries must appear in the existing Devotional Content Library page under the Mantras tab.

Extend the Motoko backend (backend/main.mo) to add stable storage and CRUD operations for: (1) BhajanEntry type (id, title, deity, artist, lyricsText, audioBase64, createdAt); (2) VratKathaEntry type (id, title, festivalName, storyText, audioBase64, createdAt); (3) HolyBookEntry type (id, bookTitle, chapterTitle, shlokaText, audioBase64, bookCategory, trackNumber, createdAt). Expose query functions: getBhajans(), getVratKathas(), getHolyBookEntries(bookTitle: Text) and update functions: addBhajan(...), updateBhajan(...), deleteBhajan(id), addVratKatha(...), updateVratKatha(...), deleteVratKatha(id), addHolyBookEntry(...), deleteHolyBookEntry(id). Seed initial mock data for all three types matching the frontend requirements (REQ-17, REQ-18, REQ-19).
